name: CCManager
where_agents_run: your machine (Windows, macOS, Linux), optionally inside devcontainers
source_note: Checked against its README, package.json, LICENSE, all 11 files in docs/, the config-skill plugin README, the npm registry (v4.4.4 and its per-platform binaries) and the GitHub releases page. Not installed or run here. Evaluated and not adopted for Pantheon (2026-09-01).

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot and more

harness_count.value: 9 named CLIs, each with its own state detection

needs_you_signal.value: Waiting flag per session; status hooks for alerts

approve_deny_prompt.value: Answer inside the session; AI auto-approve is experimental

cross_provider_delegation.value: Different agents listed side by side; no hand-off

real_terminal.value: Each session is the agent's full terminal

session_organization.value: Worktree list per project; multi-project list

saved_prompt_library.value: Not in its docs; presets save commands, not prompts

appearance_control.value: Uses your terminal's font and colors; custom shortcuts only

worktree_management.value: Create, merge and delete worktrees; setup hooks

remote_ssh.value: Not in its docs (checked 2026-09-30); devcontainers only

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux (npm binaries for each)

app_shell.value: Terminal UI (Ink/React), shipped as a Bun binary

languages.value: TypeScript (GitHub's main language; exact split not read)

background_process.value: No: closing it ends the agent sessions it started

download_size.value: v4.4.4: 24 MB macOS arm64, 40 MB Linux x64, 43 MB Windows (npm)

runs_in_terminal.value: Runs in your own terminal, no tmux needed

extensibility.value: Status and worktree hooks; no plugin API
